notes: This trace maps the portable switch test to IEEE 1516.1-2025 MOM clause 11.4.1 and the pinned IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. The test also maps directly to the Requirements Lab's Clause 11.6 source-refinement row: HLAsetSwitches sets the target joined federate's Exception Reporting switch true and false, the public getter observes each value, a second joined federate remains false, and neighboring target switches are unchanged. It does not claim HLAreportMOMexception delivery or complete MOM conformance; exception-report delivery is a separate requirement lane.

requirements.statement: The standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction permits a joined federate to send individual declared parameters; HLAexceptionReporting sets that joined federate's Exception Reporting switch, whose default is false.
